name: Neapolitan-Style Pizza Dough
source: Adapted from AVPN-style baker's percentages (62% hydration)
steps: Dissolve salt in the water. Add flour and yeast; mix to a rough dough.
Knead 10 min until smooth and elastic; rest covered 15 min.
Bulk ferment 2 h at room temperature (or 24 h in the fridge for more flavour).
Divide into 4 balls (~248 g each); rest covered 4-6 h until puffy.
Stretch each by hand to ~30 cm, leaving a thick rim. Top sparingly.
Bake as hot as your oven allows (250C+/500F+) on a stone or steel, 6-8 min.
notes: 62% hydration, ~3% salt. Use 00 flour if you have it. Scale by servings for more/fewer pizzas.
